paragraphs: Tanium sells software that gives IT and security teams continuous visibility across an entire endpoint estate. A single agent covers real-time threat hunting, autonomous detection and response, and deep forensics. Vulnerability monitoring runs continuously with risk scoring based on actual exploitability rather than CVSS alone.

A layer called Atlas sits on top, unifying investigation and remediation with agentic AI over real-time endpoint intelligence. Operators type questions in plain English and Atlas translates them into live endpoint queries. Actions then execute within autonomy limits the operator defines. Native connectors link the platform to ServiceNow, Microsoft and Splunk.

Customer pages describe Best Buy consolidating data into a single pane of glass. Another describes Leeds and York Partnership NHS Foundation Trust keeping thousands of endpoints patched and up to date. That page says the platform gives full visibility into all 3,000 PCs and servers. The homepage says the company was named a Leader and positioned furthest in Completeness of Vision in a 2026 Gartner report.

quote.text: Continuous visibility with volume, velocity, and variety across entire endpoint estate.
